records.text: Follow the iron mileposts beyond the plains to Attania. Its Ironward Company is hiring roadwardens.
The lantern road leads to Erden. Scholars there pay well for pages others mistake for rubbish.
Follow the silver barges upriver to Trisselie. The merchants are whispering about missing cargo.
The white-stone highway ends at Ariandel, The Royal Capital. Ask for the Crownward Order if you seek honorable work.
Follow the salt wind west to Velmora. The Tidebound Fellowship still searches for a lost expedition.
Captain Sera at the Ironward hall has heard nothing from her patrol. Start by searching Barren Plains.
A goblin scout was seen in Shadowed Grove carrying a warden's map. The Ironward Company will want to hear of it.
Archivist Iven lost a research party in Enchanted Forest. The Lantern Scholars need someone who can read a trail.
Bones still walk the shelves of Enchanted Library. A missing folio lies behind its restless keeper.
Factor Mirelle's ledger vanished on the Ghost Town route. Visit the Silverthread hall before chasing it.
An outlaw at Bandit Hideout has been selling cargo with silver seals. The Consortium remembers every stolen crate.
The Crownward Order in Ariandel, The Royal Capital awaits a courier from Whispering Woods. Warden Alis is worried.
A marauder in Abandoned Castle boasts of a royal seal. Ariandel, The Royal Capital cannot let that claim go unanswered.
Navigator Oren at the Tidebound hall has a chart ending at Desert Oasis. Perhaps the expedition left a journal.
The expedition's last cache was in Crystal Caverns. Sailors say one chest there has teeth.
